mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.title, v.description, v.category_id, v.cover_url, v.total_duration, v.episode_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.play_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS play_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.favorite_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS favorite_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.like_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS like_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.coin_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS coin_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.viewer_count) FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0), 0) AS viewer_count, v.user_id, v.is_ongoing, v.video_status, v.create_time, v.update_time, c.name AS category_name, u.user_name, u.nike_name, u.avatar, u.uid FROM public.video_info v LEFT JOIN public.category c ON v.category_id = c.id AND c.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON v.user_id = u.id WHERE v.id = #{id} AND v.is_delete = 0

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vs = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS partial_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN vs = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS completed_count FROM ( SELECT v.id, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 0 WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.review_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END FROM public.video_episode e WHERE e.video_id = v.id AND e.is_delete = 0) AS vs FROM public.video_info v WHERE v.is_delete = 0 ) t
